Name: Mobster Mr. Qi
Author: thingwithwings
Description:
After ages of having my eyes burned and my brain confused by the ever-blue Mr Qi, I decided to try my hand at modding!

This is a purely physical mod, changing Mr Qi's skintone and clothes into this 1930's inspired mobster look.

To install this, either put the files:

1) Into /content/characters (and /content/portraits) in your stardew valley game files (Make sure to back up your original files!!)
 or
2) Into the mods folder in your sv game files, and load the .xnb files into SMAPI like you would any others!

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
